definitions: deal with a problem only when it arises or becomes necessary, rather than worrying about it in advance
examples: Don't worry about potential issues with the new project yet; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
I'm not sure how we'll handle the increased demand, but we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
lemma: cross that bridge when one comes to it
source: we'll cross that bridge when we come to it
